title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

Your Role and Impact:

  • Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.

  • Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.

  • Value Articulation: Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.

  • Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.

  • Technical Credibility: Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.

  • Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.

  • Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.


This Role is a Fit for You If:

title: Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Efficiency Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will use and help develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to ship quickly, applying the coding fundamentals and judgement needed to stand behind what reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step.

We are looking for:

  • Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

  • A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

  • Practical agentic engineering experience: you use coding agents effectively and can develop and evaluate their workflows, while independently understanding, reviewing and debugging the code they produce.

  • A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

  • Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Why Join

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.

We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

description:
Die Position

BERLIN · ab sofort · befristet bis 31.12.2027 

Teilzeit – 32 Std./Woche | Besetzung vorbehaltlich der Mittelzusage

Bewerbungsfrist: 30.09.2026, 13.00 Uhr 


Du möchtest gesellschaftlich relevante Themen verständlich, sensibel und zielgruppengerecht erzählen? Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream.


Über uns

GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen.

Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate.


Deine Rolle


Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate.

Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen.

Du entwickelst Formate und Kampagnen in enger Abstimmung mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektteam und den eingebundenen Fachrollen. Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick.

So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann.



Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet

Content, Redaktion und Storytelling
  • Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit.
  • Du bereitest komplexe fachliche Inhalte verständlich, niedrigschwellig und zielgruppengerecht auf.
  • Du gestaltest Texte, Posts, Kurzvideos und weitere digitale Formate rund um die Themen und Aktivitäten des Projekts.
  • Du erzählst Geschichten aus Workshops, Qualifizierungen, Kooperationen und Veranstaltungen und machst die Menschen und Perspektiven hinter dem Projekt sichtbar.
  • Du achtest darauf, dass jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll, differenziert und diskriminierungssensibel dargestellt werden.
  • Du passt Inhalte an die jeweiligen Kanäle, Zielgruppen und Plattformlogiken an.

Kampagnen, Social Media und Medienproduktion
  • Du entwickelst und realisierst Kommunikationsformate, Contenstrecken und Kampagnen im Rahmen des Projektes.
  • Du betreust die projektbezogenen Inhalte auf den Social-Media-Kanälen von GermanDream und sorgst für eine verlässliche Veröffentlichung.
  • Du planst und begleitest Veranstaltungen, Videodrehs, Interviews und Videoporträts, breitest Fragen und Abläufe vor und stimmst dich dazu mit allen Beteiligten ab.
  • Du begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen vor Ort, filmst selbst mit und sammelst geeignetes Foto-, Video- und O-Ton-Material.
  • Du schneidest kurze Videoformate selbst und koordinierst weitere Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Beteiligten.
  • Du bereitest Inhalte, Materialien und Ergebnisse aus dem Projekt für unsere Kommunikationskanäle auf.
  • Du unterstützt das Community Management auf unseren Kanälen, wertest Rückmeldungen aus und hältst vereinbarte Moderations- und Eskalationswege ein.
  • Du greifst relevante Entwicklungen und Debatten in Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Räumen auf und entwickelst daraus passende Kommunikationsansätze.

Zusammenarbeit, Planung und Auswertung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektmanagement und den eingebundenen Fachrollen zusammen und stimmst fachlich sensible Inhalte eng mit ihnen ab.
  • Du holst rechtzeitig Informationen, Materialien und Freigaben ein und sorgst für klare Absprachen und nächste Schritte.
  • Du pflegst Redaktionspläne und behältst Veröffentlichungen, Termine und Produktionsabläufe im Blick.
  • Du strukturierst und pflegst Content-, Foto- und Medienablagen, insbesondere in Notion und Teams.
  • Du achtest auf einen konsistenten visuellen und sprachlichen Auftritt entlang der Brand Guidelines von GermanDream.
  • Du wertest Reichweite, Resonanz und relevante Kennzahlen aus und leitest daraus Learnings für die weitere Kommunikation ab.
  • Du bringst Erkenntnisse, Rückmeldungen und aktuelle Entwicklungen in die Weiterentwicklung von Inhalten, Formaten und Kampagnen ein.
  • Du machst frühzeitig sichtbar, wenn Inhalte, Termine oder Produktionsabläufe angepasst werden müssen.


Was du für die Rolle mitbringst

  • Du hast erste bis mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Kommunikation, Social Media, Content Creation, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit oder einem vergleichbaren Arbeitsfeld.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Storytelling, Sprache, Bildwelten und digitale Formate.
  • Du kannst gesellschaftspolitische und fachlich komplexe Themen verständlich und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Content, insbesondere Text, Grafik und Video.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Kreativtools wie Adobe Creative Cloud und CapCut oder arbeitest dich sehr schnell in neue Anwendungen ein.
  • Du kennst Plattformen wie Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und LinkedIn und verstehst ihre unterschiedlichen Formate, Zielgruppen und Funktionsweisen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung, Begleitung oder Umsetzung von Videodrehs und Interviews und Social-Media-Produktionen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei parallelen Veröffentlichungen, Abstimmungen und Terminen den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpersonen und arbeitest gerne im Team.
  • Du interessierst dich für Antisemitismusprävention, Demokratiebildung und gesellschaftspolitische Debatten.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn, gesellschaftlicher Relevanz und direktem Praxisbezug.
  • Ein Projekt, das antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit mit Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Lebenswelten verbindet.

Sende uns bis zum 30.09.2026, 13 Uhr über unsere Bewerbungsplattform:

  • deinen Lebenslauf,
  • eine kurze Motivation – als Text oder Video – und

title: Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, UGV Platforms (m/f/d)
description:
Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. 

This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership

    • Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275).

    • Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve.

    • Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers during qualification and acceptance.

  • EMC by Design

    • Develop and integrate the grounding, bonding, shielding and harness concept for the complete vehicle, with special focus on high voltage and high power electronics: traction inverters, DC/DC converters, battery systems and chargers together with outstanding team of engineers

    • Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts.

    • Manage RF coexistence on a dense platform:  datalinks, GNSS, tactical radios and payload emitters working side by side without degrading each other.

    • Flow down EMC requirements to suppliers, run component level reviews and assess their test evidence.

  • Test, Troubleshooting and Qualification

    • Build our in house pre compliance lab (LISN, spectrum analyser, near field probes, current clamps, automated measurement scripts) so issues are found on the bench, not in the chamber.

    • Plan, witness and lead full compliance campaigns at component, subsystem and vehicle level; drive root cause analysis and verified fixes when tests fail.

    • Use simulation (e.g. FEKO, CST, LTspice) where it saves test iterations.

  • Cross Functional Collaboration and Standards

    • Work closely with payload integration, vehicle E/E, mechanical, autonomy and manufacturing teams so EMC is built in, not bolted on.

    • Create EMC control plans, test procedures, reports and qualification evidence, and turn lessons learned into internal EMC design rules for every future platform and payload.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics or a comparable technical field.

  • 8+ years of EMC experience in automotive, commercial vehicle, rail, aerospace or defence, including ownership of at least one product through formal qualification or type approval.

  • Deep knowledge of automotive EMC (e.g. UN ECE R10, CISPR 25, ISO 11452, ISO 7637, ISO 10605) and working knowledge of military EMC (MIL-STD-461; ideally MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500, DEF STAN 59-411 or VG 95370/95373). Strong automotive profiles willing to extend into the military world are very welcome.

  • Solid experience with EMC of high voltage and power electronics systems.

  • Practical measurement expertise at component and vehicle level, and the ability to set up and automate test systems (e.g. Python, Matlab).

  • Structured root cause analysis, ideally backed by methods such as Six Sigma, and audit ready documentation.

  • Confident communication with engineers, suppliers, test labs, authorities and military customers.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • High ownership, focus on teamwork, pragmatic, and happy to work directly on vehicles and in the workshop.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.
